name: core::marker::variance::PhantomCovariant
src:
#[attr = Repr {reprs: [ReprTransparent]}]
#[doc = r" Zero-sized type used to mark a type parameter as covariant."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" Types used as part of the return value from a function are covariant. If the type is _also_"]
#[doc =
r" passed as a parameter then it is [invariant][PhantomInvariant]. See [the reference][1] for"]
#[doc = r" more information."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" [1]: https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/reference/subtyping.html#variance"]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" Note: If `T` is otherwise contravariant or invariant, the resulting type is invariant."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc = r" ## Layout"]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc = r" For all `T`, the following are guaranteed:"]
#[doc = r" * `size_of::<PhantomCovariant<T>>() == 0`"]
#[doc = r" * `align_of::<PhantomCovariant<T>>() == 1`"]
pub struct $name<$t>($($inner)*) where $t: ?Sized;
